Seven pillars, one journey

Unique Junior School

Warm foundational learning nurturing curiosity, literacy, and moral character.

Conceptual discovery and ethical roots

Unique High School for Boys

Disciplined secondary sciences, laboratory practice, and analytical reasoning.

Matriculation and scientific inquiry

Unique High School for Girls

Empowering secondary education fostering clarity, confidence, and compassion.

Dedicated campus and mentorship

Unique College for Boys

Pre-Medical, Pre-Engineering, ICS and Commerce pathways for higher education.

Structured pre-university readiness

Unique College for Girls

Scholarly intermediate studies combining modern knowledge with cultural values.

Focused faculty guidance

Unique Science Academy

The founding pillar of UGI since 1986, renowned for evening concept mastery and testing.

Where UGI began in 1986

Unique Entry Test Preparation

Targeted analytical and aptitude preparation for MDCAT, ECAT, and competitive tests.

Precision drills and mock assessments

What is this website?

The digital showcase for the UGI 2026 exhibition. For admissions and official notices, visit unique.edu.pk.

When is the UGI 2026 exhibition?

Dates will be announced by UGI. A live countdown appears here once they are confirmed.
